## Où j'en suis
Tom's branch `tom/dashboard-keyboard` adds keyboard move/resize and a visible focus ring to the dashboard grid, as the follow-up to PR #418 (merged). Keyboard support is implemented in `useGridKeyboard()` with 11 new tests passing, committed as `8f1a2c7`, and PR #423 is open with Priya requested as reviewer. The `dashboards_v2` flag is on for zest-grocers in staging only; production is untouched. (source: ses-db-4, d4-05, d4-07, kestrel-analytics/platform#423, 8f1a2c7)

- [en-cours] Priya's review of PR #423 (keyboard move/resize and focus ring) (source: kestrel-analytics/platform#423)
- [prochaine-étape] Get PR #423 reviewed and merged (source: kestrel-analytics/platform#423)
- [prochaine-étape] Priya rehearses the Zest demo on staging (source: d4-06)
- [prochaine-étape] Flip `dashboards_v2` on in production the morning of the 24th, for Zest only (source: d4-06, b2-04)
- [essai-raté] dnd-kit's KeyboardSensor applied every move twice and broke the mouse drag test, and fixing that meant rewriting the grid; removed (source: d4-02, d4-04)
- [essai-raté] CSS container queries do nothing on Zest's iPads (iOS 15, Safari < 16) (source: b2-01)
- [décision] Own keyboard handler on top of the layout state, no dnd-kit (source: d4-04)
- [décision] Keep recharts, visx migration abandoned, PR #401 closed (source: c3-03, kestrel-analytics/platform#401)
- [décision] ResizeObserver instead of container queries, all `@container` rules removed (source: b2-02)
- [décision] Flag on for Zest only, legacy v1 dashboards stay behind the flag until January, nothing removed now (source: b2-04)
